nodes.label: Strategy
nodes.question: What is the main goal of the study conducted in the Yangtze River basin?
nodes.answer: The main goal is to understand how socio-ecological systems (SESs) respond to land use and climate changes to develop effective integrated watershed management strategies.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Sustainable water resource management|River basin management_qna_001
nodes.label: Analysis
nodes.question: What method does the study propose to analyze the SES in the Yangtze River basin?
nodes.answer: The study proposes a network analysis method to construct an SES network comprising six dimensions.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Clean water and sanitation|Sustainable water resource management|River basin management_qna_002
nodes.label: Facts
nodes.question: What role does the Yangtze River Basin (YRB) play in China?
nodes.answer: The Yangtze River Basin serves as a vital ecological shield, energy hub, and agricultural heartland of China.
